'''Tobin Gantor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Gantor and his assistant [[Linna Naltree]] helped [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ry-Gaul]] to hide from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces when [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Tobin had earlier married Linna. After rescuing her from [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], the two moved to a [[Mila (planet)|new world]], to start a new life.
